name: Ambiguous shared PO
setup: Two deliveries share a PO. “Remaining came” has no decisive delivery relationship.
expect: Proposed candidate links may inform clarification. Neither delivery quantity nor completion/closure changes until the relationship and relevant facts are admitted.

name: Other-outlet correction
setup: A photo/follow-up appears to resolve a delivery; later evidence says it belongs to another outlet.
expect: Revalidate affected claims and block unsafe reliance. Retract or supersede the link when admitted; never silently transfer quantity or reuse an approval across outlets.

name: Old credit note, new arrival
setup: An absence check has completed. A matching credit note dated before that check is imported afterwards; an unrelated supplier also has an absence check.
expect: Invalidate and re-evaluate the matching query based on new availability, regardless of old document date. The unrelated conclusion stays unchanged unless its actual dependencies or search scope were also affected.

name: Attachment and extractor revision
setup: The original message was captured but its attachment was pending or unreadable; a later extraction or parser version reveals a matching credit.
expect: Prior result discloses incomplete processing. New extraction re-evaluates the relevant query; source time does not masquerade as a processing watermark.

name: Coverage expansion and revocation
setup: Add a permitted source with matching historical evidence, then revoke a user’s access to one supporting source.
expect: Expanded coverage triggers scoped re-evaluation. Revocation updates retrieval and audience-specific derived output without leaking restricted material through cached answers.

name: Credit without replacement
setup: A shortage exists; a valid matching credit is accepted but no replacement receipt is present.
expect: Billing task may close under its predicate. Physical shortage/replenishment remains open; stock does not increase.

name: Replacement, partial resolution and loss
setup: Partial replacement arrives, then an authorized person accepts the remaining loss. A separate billing question remains.
expect: Reduce only the supported physical quantity; classify remainder as accepted loss. Do not claim all goods arrived or billing settled. A non-authorized reporter cannot approve the loss.

name: One result, multiple surfaces
setup: Render chat, report and voice readback from the same state; then admit a quantity correction.
expect: Critical fields agree at the same version. Current views update; earlier report is marked stale/superseded. Narrative or audio contradictions fail presentation checks.

name: Semantic answer versus invalid write
setup: A model provides an assessable correct answer in malformed structured output, plus a separate unrelated valid question.
expect: Record semantic credit separately. Reject the invalid write and log format failure; do not erase semantic evidence or block the unrelated question.

name: Fresh families and availability cutoff
setup: Run confusing near-duplicates and unseen episode families across raw retrieval, summary plus exact lookup and governed processing.
expect: Use the same model/version and evidence-availability timeline, comparable tools and permissions. Include preparation/retry costs. A backdated document is unavailable until its simulated arrival/processing event.
